title: Paper2Agent : Reimagining Research Papers As Interactive and Reliable AI Agents
abstract: Paper2Agent is an automated framework that converts research papers into AI agents, making it easier for scientists to apply methods and techniques from papers to their own work. This framework transforms research output from passive artifacts into active systems, accelerating downstream use, adoption, and discovery.

sections.title: The Core Insight
sections.content: Imagine having a personal research assistant that can understand and apply the methods from any research paper. Paper2Agent makes this possible by converting papers into interactive AI agents. You can ask these agents questions, request demonstrations, or apply the method to new data, all through natural language.

sections.title: How It Works
sections.content: Paper2Agent works by analyzing the paper and its associated codebase, then constructing a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server. This server exposes the paper's methods and tools, making them accessible to AI agents. The agent can then be connected to the MCP server, enabling natural language interaction with the paper's methods.

sections.title: Benchmark Results
sections.content: The Paper2Agent-generated AlphaGenome agent achieved 100.0% accuracy on 15 example queries, outperforming other agentic systems. It also showed improved computational efficiency, with a median decrease in run time of 1.8x and 3.1x compared to other agents.

sections.title: Why This Matters
sections.content: Paper2Agent has the potential to revolutionize the way we interact with research papers. By converting papers into interactive AI agents, it can accelerate discovery and make it easier for scientists to apply new methods and techniques to their own work.

sections.title: Key Innovations
sections.content: Paper2Agent introduces a new paradigm for knowledge dissemination by transforming research papers into interactive AI agents. The Model Context Protocol (MCP) server is a key innovation, enabling the exposure of paper methods and tools to AI agents.

sections.title: Try It Yourself
sections.content: You can try Paper2Agent for yourself by connecting to a demo server. Simply ask the agent a question or request a demonstration, and see how it can help you with your research.
